This Writ Petition (Civil) Having Come Up For Admission On
04.02.2026, The Court On The Same Day Delivered The Following:

The petitioners have preferred Ext.P6 representation before the 3rd respondent - Secretary, against the Corporation's attempt to forcibly evict them, claiming rights under the Street Vendors (Protection of Livelihood and Regulation of Street Vending) Act, 2014.

sentences.text: 2. Taking note of the above, there will be a direction to the 3 rd respondent to consider and pass orders in Ext.P6, in accordance with law, with notice to the petitioners, within two months from the date of receipt of a copy of this judgment.
All the contentions of the parties are left open.
The writ petition is disposed of as above.
